scientific_question: Can the exact nine-view parallel detector normal be constructed directly from one-dimensional vertical and two-dimensional horizontal primitives, without materialising a three-dimensional dense A or B, and then reproduce zero-start CGLS K4 while reducing fresh-process time and memory over a full 101-call workload?
evidence_role: post-open scalable-construction and resource gate after the v61 small dense structural audit; no PoolFire truth, validation, fresh trajectory, test trajectory, calibrated camera, curved ray, learned correction, or real BOST is read

scratch_completed_before_freeze: The already opened v61 8x8x8, 8x8-detector, nine-view parallel geometry was used to test a direct primitive construction.

The scratch formed one-dimensional interpolation and derivative matrices plus two-dimensional horizontal ray-integration and directional-derivative matrices; it did not materialise dense three-dimensional A or B for the candidate.
One seeded random-field forward comparison had relative error 2.3950318496672986e-16 and maximum absolute difference 1.7763568394002505e-15.
One seeded random detector-vector B action comparison had relative error 5.262101651896927e-16 and maximum absolute difference 1.4210854715202004e-14.

A timing-only target-shape scratch measured approximately 9.49 ms per matrix-free A, 9.16 ms per A-transpose, and 18.23 ms per matrix-free B on the current Mac; no analytic-factor target-shape timing or formal output was seen.
formal_changes_after_scratch: The formal field changes from 8x8x8 to 32x16x16 in z-y-x order.
The formal detector changes from 8x8 to 32x16 in v-u order.
The formal ray sample count changes from 32 to 64.

The formal gate adds 17 random forward checks, 17 random B actions, five K4 replays, a no-dense-A-or-B construction audit, a matrix-free detector-CR control, 17 fresh repetitions, 5-call diagnostics, 101-call primary workloads, paired wall tails, setup reporting, worker-self RSS, and sampled process-tree RSS.
not_seen_before_freeze: No formal v62 analytic-factor result exists.
No formal v62 independent validation exists.
No target-shape analytic-factor compute, outer-wall, setup, worker-self RSS, or process-tree RSS result exists.
No PoolFire, BLASTNet, validation, fresh, stopping-validation, untouched-test, experimental, or group-private truth is read.

formal_geometry.ray_model: parallel straight rays rotating in the xy plane with detector-v fixed to z

two-dimensional horizontal path-integration, directional-derivative, and support matrices
pairwise vertical and horizontal detector-normal factors

fresh_resource_gate.workload_boundary: Five immutable seeded observations are cycled in fixed order. The 101-call workload measures setup amortisation only; it is not 101 independent fields, a new CFD trajectory, or generalisation evidence.
fresh_resource_gate.matrix_free_detector_cr_role: exact data-space negative control showing that changing Krylov coordinates alone does not remove A/A-transpose work

required_reporting: Report direct analytic-factor construction time and persistent bytes; do not hide them as offline setup.
For 5 and 101 calls report per-arm setup, compute, worker-lifetime, and outer-wall p50, p90, worst, and mean.
For both workloads report worker-self ru_maxrss and independently sampled process-tree RSS, naming their scopes correctly.
Report all three complete A/A-transpose/analytic-B ledgers and verify output norms or digests for every worker.
Report exactness per random field, random detector action, and K4 observation; means may not hide a failing item.
Report that the 101-call workload cycles five immutable seeded observations and is not generalisation.

pass_requires: The no-dense-A-or-B and no-SVD construction contract passes.
Every forward, B-action, K4 field, K4 residual, and adjoint exactness check passes.
Persistent factor state is within the frozen maximum.
The primary 101-call compute, outer-wall p50, outer-wall p90, worker-self RSS, and sampled process-tree RSS gates all pass.
The independent validator reproduces all exactness metrics, resource rows, and the final decision.

next_if_pass: Freeze pinhole, elevation, roll, and calibrated-ray stress tests against the exact parallel core. Only if the deployment-visible residual has stable bounded structure may a minimum geometry-conditioned correction operator be trained.
next_if_fail: Record the failed dimension separately: algebra, setup, compute, outer wall, worker memory, or process-tree memory. Do not rescue a resource failure by enlarging a neural model; compare CSR-A, streaming, and fixed-geometry PCGLS before changing the physical representation.
